blocks.text: Origin / creation. A living Era Three person developed from a reduced continuity core through embodiment, care, local relationships, choice, and experience before or during the Gate contact.
Identity / human status. Cyber-pet, not human and not an intact DBA. Whether it already possessed a local name is unresolved.

Importance. It interpreted, accepted, altered, or potentially refused the child’s offered name through its own developing identity. The resulting persistent relation restored num between inside and outside.
Decline or later status. Not established. The being must not be written as disappearing into a save file or being overwritten by an ancient source identity.
Final status / surviving function. Active at Era Four’s opening. Its case defines naming as recognition rather than ownership and makes the player–pet bond a mutual developmental relation.
